$comment: Used by the check-jsonschema pre-commit hook (see .pre-commit-config.yaml) to validate .devcontainer/devcontainer.json. Layers VS Code's customizations.vscode typing on top of the upstream base spec schema. The upstream combined schema (devContainer.schema.json) also pulls in microsoft/vscode's devContainer.vscode.schema.json, but that fragment types 'settings' and 'mcp' via 'vscode://schemas/...' URIs that only VS Code's own editor can resolve, so a generic validator can't use it. 'extensions' (the property we actually rely on for typo-catching) needs no such URI, so it's reproduced here verbatim from microsoft/vscode's schema; 'settings' and 'mcp' are left as plain objects instead of chasing the unresolvable refs.

extensions.description: An array of extensions that should be installed into the container. A minus '-' in front of the extension id removes it from the list of extensions to be installed.

settings.description: Machine specific settings that should be copied into the container.

devPort.description: The port VS Code can use to connect to its backend.
